name: The Old Hound
lore: The Vale says the Chalk Hound was cut on the down over something already lying there, and scoured white every seventh summer to keep it lying down. Down wolves are lean and grey-gold and work in fours. This one is as white as scoured chalk and works alone, and the wolves of Hound Down come to it the way hounds come to their master's whistle. It has been lying on a scourer's cord for seven years, keeping it taut.

phases.name: the eye opens
phases.say: It throws back its head and gives tongue, and from every bore of the swallet the pack answers and comes.
